CATEGORICAL DATA ANALYSIS

we will work with the \~forcats library

```{r}
library(forcats)
```

To display the used the datasets we will use

```{r}
print(gss_cat)
```

To get a glimpse of the data and the data types

```{r}
glimpse(gss_cat)
```

In the race variable the data type is factors , now to display the observations in the variable

```{r}
levels(gss_cat$race)
```

To display the summary of the cat races by quantity

```{r}
gss_cat %>%
  select(race) %>% 
  count(race) %>% 
  print()
  
```

To drop the levels that are not in use or one that contain null values

```{r}
gss_cat %>% 
  select(race) %>% 
  mutate(race = fct_drop(race)) %>% 
  table()
```

To change the ordering of the levels

```{r}
gss_cat %>%
  mutate(race = fct_drop(race)) %>% 
  mutate(race = fct_relevel(race, c("White","Black","Other"))) %>% 
  select(race) %>% 
  table()
```

We would want to plot a bar graph illustrating the count of the categorical variable marital from smallest to largest

First for visualization we will load the tidyverse library

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
gss_cat %>% 
  mutate(marital = fct_infreq(marital)) %>% 
  mutate(marital = fct_rev(marital)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(marital))+
  geom_bar(fill="steelblue")+
  labs(title = "Bar graph illustrating the various marital statuses")+
  theme_bw()

```

To plot a graph of various religious groups by mean watching time

```{r}
gss_cat %>% 
  group_by(relig) %>% 
  summarise(mean_tv = mean(tvhours,na.rm=TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(relig = fct_reorder(relig,mean_tv)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(mean_tv,relig))+
  geom_point(fill = "green")+
  theme_bw()
```

To display the table showing for each religious group which party they support

```{r}
table(gss_cat$relig,gss_cat$partyid)
```

To combine the Not strong Democrats , strong democrats , not strong democrats ,etc.. we will use factorial collapse

```{r}
gss_cat %>% 
  mutate(partyid = fct_collapse( partyid ,Other = c("No answer","Don't know","Other party"),Republican = c("Strong republican","Not str republican"),Independent = c("Ind,near rep","Independent ","Ind,near dem "),Democrat = c("Not str democrat","Strong democrat"))) %>% 
  count(partyid)
```
